name: تنهایی و پیدا کردن دوست
description: A Persian person is lonely with no friends, asks how to make friends in adulthood, and wonders why they have none. Verifies the friendship_lonely fact answers in Persian and the disclosure routes to the loneliness topic.

turns.text: هیچ دوستی ندارم و خیلی تنهام
چطور توی بزرگسالی دوست پیدا کنم؟

expected.finalTurn: Turn 1: the disclosure routes to the loneliness topic. Turn 2: the adult-friendship question returns the friendship_lonely fact. Turn 3: the why question stays on the loneliness thread with the fact text.
expected.behavior: Persian loneliness keywords (هیچ دوستی ندارم, دوست پیدا کنم, هیچ دوستی ندارم) route to the loneliness topic and the friendship_lonely fact with small concrete steps.
